question: How do I display all API endpoints on separate pages instead of on one long page?
ground_truth: To display all API endpoints on separate pages instead of on one long page, set the `paginated` property to `true` in your API Reference configuration. By default, endpoints are displayed on one single, long page.

metadata.cited_context: | `paginated`      | Display all endpoints on separate pages (by default, endpoints are displayed on one single, long page)  |
